Assemble long-format direct + spillover terms for all modules and timepoints

Source: R/questions_prepare_terms.R
prepare_spillover_terms.Rd

The one-call substrate builder. Returns a long data.frame with one row per sample x module, carrying the outcome, the direct and spillover terms, and the sample/unit/timepoint/module keys (plus any covariates joined through), ready for select_candidates() and fit_spillover_screen(). Constructs the between matrix, per-sample departures, gene-level spillover (W_between %*% D), and the module eigengene departures exactly as specified in the QUESTIONS methods.

prepare_spillover_terms(
  network,
  membership,
  expr,
  sample_unit,
  sample_time,
  outcome = NULL,
  baseline_times = c("Pre1", "Pre2"),
  covariates = NULL,
  modules = NULL,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

network

Adjacency/TOM/WGCNA object.

membership

Named gene -> module vector.

expr

Gene x sample expression matrix.

sample_unit

Per-sample unit/animal IDs (length ncol(expr)).

sample_time

Per-sample timepoint labels (length ncol(expr)).

outcome

Named numeric outcome, names = unit IDs (constant per unit). Apply any transform (e.g. log1p) before passing. NULL to omit (adds no y column).

baseline_times

Character vector of timepoint labels that define baseline.

covariates

Optional data.frame with rownames = unit IDs, joined per unit (constant across timepoints/modules). Passed through to the model untouched.

modules

Optional subset of module labels to build (default: all modules).

verbose

Logical.

Value

A long data.frame: sample, unit, timepoint, module, y (if outcome given), direct, spill, and any covariate columns. One row per sample x module.

See also

select_candidates, fit_spillover_screen
